description: Header file defining the wifiManager class for managing WiFi operations using NetworkManager on Raspberry Pi 4, including connection management, scanning, WPS, and interface configuration.

classes.name: wifiManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing WiFi operations via NetworkManager, including connection, scanning, WPS, and interface configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of wifiManager.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a known WiFi connection by interface and optional connection ID.

methods.name: wifiConnectedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSID info of the connected WiFi network.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a WiFi network using provided SSID info.

methods.name: wifiScanRequest
methods.description: Requests a WiFi scan, optionally for a specific SSID.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if WiFi scan was performed within a recent time limit.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi network to known SSIDs.

methods.name: removeKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes an SSID from known list.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Terminates WiFi operations for a given NMDevice.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a GMainLoop to complete or timeout.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a network interface.

methods.name: setIpSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for an interface.
